statusDetail: Atomic coverage complete across 58 checks and five representative public paths. Logged-in account management, payment, live-chat and destructive registration submission were not covered.

paths.description: Homepage/catalogue entry, first viewport, consent surface, theme, narrow layout, performance, privacy, accessibility and crawlability.
Category-index archetype representing long listing/navigation templates.
Representative video detail archetype for title, canonical, social/structured metadata and mobile presentation.
Primary account-creation entry flow, disclosures, social/email choices and narrow-screen usability.
Intentional missing route representing recovery/error state.

findings.summary: Animations continue when reduced motion is requested
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe matched prefers-reduced-motion: reduce but still found eight running, infinite 2-second shimmer animations.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable shimmer and other non-essential looping animation inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not use View Transitions
findings.evidence: The platform probe found zero view-transition rules across the loaded stylesheets, while the site exposes many route and modal state changes.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance route and modal changes with same-document and cross-document View Transitions, retaining an instant fallback.

findings.summary: Long pages provide no scroll-state-aware navigation cue
findings.evidence: The 4,011px homepage and 7,482px categories surface have static chrome; the CSS probe found no scroll-state query or scroll timeline rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll progress or compacting sticky header using scroll-state/container queries, with a conventional fallback.

findings.summary: Cookie dialog obscures most of the first viewport
findings.evidence: The fresh-load desktop screenshot shows a large centered consent dialog covering the content before interaction. Accept and reject are both available, but the interruption dominates the page.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, content-preserving consent surface where legally permitted; retain equally prominent accept/reject and a clear settings path.

findings.summary: Modal surfaces use custom role=dialog containers instead of native dialog
findings.evidence: The signup probe found a DIV with role=dialog and aria-modal=true; no native dialog or popover elements were present in the platform probe.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> for modal flows and popover for transient UI so focus, top-layer placement and dismissal are platform-managed.

findings.summary: Desktop layout is forced into narrow viewports
findings.evidence: At a requested 360x800 viewport, layout measured scrollWidth 1024px versus clientWidth 360px, 664px of horizontal overflow. Category, detail and signup screenshots show clipped desktop surfaces; the signup panel is almost entirely off-screen.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a genuinely responsive layout independent of user-agent detection; remove 1024px minimums, use intrinsic/fluid sizing, and verify every primary surface at 320-412px.

findings.summary: Components do not adapt at container level
findings.evidence: The stylesheet probe found zero @container rules, while the reused navigation, cards and signup panel visibly clip when their available width narrows.
findings.suggestedFix: Define containment for reusable cards, navigation and modal panels and adapt them with size container queries, keeping viewport fallbacks.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly indicated on key controls
findings.evidence: Programmatically focused search input and submit button computed outline: none 0px. Lighthouse also reported target-spacing failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a high-contrast :focus-visible style and ensure targets have at least 24px safe spacing, preferably 44px for primary touch controls.

findings.summary: Signup flow is clipped and cannot be completed at the tested narrow viewport
findings.evidence: The 360px signup screenshot renders its right-side registration panel beyond the viewport, leaving only a narrow clipped strip and making the primary registration options unusable.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the registration dialog fit the visual viewport, stack actions on narrow screens, and test email/social registration through completion at mobile widths.

findings.summary: Lab LCP is outside the good range
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 3.2s (score 0.71), above the 2.5s good threshold, although CLS was 0 and TBT was 0ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the LCP element, prioritize its discovery/delivery, and defer non-critical scripts and styles.

findings.summary: The entry page ships a large, fragmented critical load
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 140 requests and 1,850,742 transferred bytes, including 61 scripts (1,048,900 bytes), 11 stylesheets and multiple parser-inserted render-blocking stylesheet candidates.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate critical CSS, defer non-critical bundles, reduce request fragmentation and preserve long-lived caching for versioned assets.

findings.summary: Unused CSS and JavaScript are shipped on initial load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 26KiB unused JavaScript and 57KiB unused CSS; HAR shows a 402KiB index script as the largest response.
findings.suggestedFix: Split template-specific code, remove dead selectors and load optional features only when their surface is requested.

findings.summary: Interactive controls and links lack accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found two unnamed buttons and two links in the mobile homepage that are keyboard-focusable without accessible text.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control a programmatic name matching its visible purpose; avoid nested or redundant interactive targets.

findings.summary: Important text fails minimum color contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured contrast as low as 1.75:1 and 2.15:1 on the green age-verification banner and 3.29:1 on repeated view-count text, below the 4.5:1 minimum.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to meet WCAG AA in every theme and re-test repeated card metadata and banners.

findings.summary: Focus visibility and interactive semantics are unreliable
findings.evidence: The focus probe found no visible outline on the search input/button; Lighthouse found unnamed controls/links, undermining a predictable keyboard focus walk.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native interactive elements, unique accessible names and a consistent :focus-visible treatment that follows reading order.

findings.summary: Mobile zoom/reflow and target spacing fail accessibility expectations
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found the mobile viewport disables user scaling and reported undersized/overlapping targets; the 360px raw-CDP layout also overflowed by 664px.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow pinch zoom, reflow without horizontal scrolling, and increase target size/spacing.

findings.summary: Image delivery lacks stable dimensions and appropriate sizing
findings.evidence: The image audit found 29 of 36 images without width/height, 12 oversized images and 8 below-fold images without lazy loading.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio, choose responsive source candidates close to rendered size and lazy-load below-fold media.

findings.summary: Sitemap discovery is incomplete
findings.evidence: robots.txt returned 200, but /sitemap.xml returned 404. Canonicals point from xhsocial.com to the xhamster.com host, which should be intentionally verified across all localized variants.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish and reference locale-aware sitemap indexes and verify cross-host canonical/hreflang consistency.

findings.summary: Video detail page omits structured video metadata
findings.evidence: The representative video detail exposes Open Graph tags but no JSON-LD or microdata, despite representing a rich VideoObject.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org VideoObject JSON-LD matching the visible title, thumbnail, duration, upload date and canonical URL.

findings.summary: Cookies and CSP do not provide a strong secure baseline
findings.evidence: The headers probe found CSP limited to frame-ancestors only and no X-Content-Type-Options or Referrer-Policy. Cookie audit found three insecure issues, including settings and CSRF cookies without Secure and SameSite=None cookies.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure on every HTTPS cookie, review SameSite=None necessity, add nosniff and a strict Referrer-Policy, and expand CSP beyond clickjacking protection.

findings.summary: Extensive third-party traffic occurs before a consent choice
findings.evidence: A fresh-load HAR recorded 116 third-party requests and 1,657,764 third-party bytes while the consent dialog was still displayed; requests included Google accounts, ad/media domains and 80 requests to static-ah.xhcdn.com.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate non-essential advertising, analytics and identity requests until consent; minimize origin count and document each processor/purpose.

findings.summary: Signup offers Google, X and email but no phishing-resistant first-party path
findings.evidence: The signup surface offers Google, X and email; the platform/runtime probes found no WebAuthn/passkey affordance while authentication is clearly relevant. No permission prompt fired on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration and authentication alongside existing methods and request permissions only after a user gesture.

findings.summary: Defensive response policies are incomplete
findings.evidence: HSTS is only one day; nosniff and Referrer-Policy are absent, Permissions-Policy only delegates two client-hint features, and CSP has no script/style/default-src controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a least-privilege CSP, longer reviewed HSTS policy, nosniff, strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter referrer policy, and an explicit Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Localized layout relies overwhelmingly on physical CSS properties
findings.evidence: The Thai document correctly declares lang=th and offers many locale routes, but stylesheet inspection found 705 physical left/right declarations versus only 18 logical-property uses.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace directional spacing and positioning with inline/block logical properties and test an RTL locale plus long translated labels.

findings.summary: Account entry is not reliably usable on mobile
findings.evidence: The signup/account dialog is visually clipped outside the tested 360px viewport, so consent and account choices are not proportionately available on a common form factor.
findings.suggestedFix: Reflow account and consent controls within the viewport and verify registration, login, cancellation and account-management journeys with keyboard and mobile input.

findings.summary: Asset sizing wastes transfer and decode work
findings.evidence: Image inspection found 12 images more than twice their displayed width, 17 legacy-format entries and 8 below-fold images loaded eagerly.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP responsive candidates sized to the slot and defer below-fold/decorative media.

findings.summary: Third-party cost dominates the page budget
findings.evidence: HAR attributes 1.66MB of 1.85MB and 116 of 140 requests to third-party origins, disproportionate for the first content view before consent.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget, defer optional media and identity scripts, and block non-essential work before consent.
